newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates close sharply higher.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates close sharply higher.

text.p: Intensifying liquidity demand for next week's Chinese lunar new year pushed Taiwan's money rates to close sharply higher on Friday, and dealers expected further gains.
The overnight interbank rate ended at 6.203 percent against Thursday's 5.773 close, with the 30-day commercial paper jumping to 6.50-7.00 percent against 5.65-5.75 percent.
Dealers expected liquidity to remain tight ahead of the February 7 Chinese new year despite the central bank's repeated fund injections to ease the banking system's liquidity.
The bond market was quiet in afternoon trade.
The 10-year 86/4 bond yield was at 6.0805-6.0820 early in the session.
